speakers.headline: Chief Technology Officer @altermAInd
speakers.biographyMd:
Gabriele is a technology leader with extensive experience in building digital platforms and enterprise software solutions. He currently works on AI-driven products focused on transforming how people learn, work, and make decisions inside organizations.

With a background in software architecture and large-scale systems, he has led projects in banking, fintech, and cloud-native environments, helping companies adopt modern architectures and artificial intelligence in real business scenarios.

Today his main focus is on the impact of AI on society and the workplace, exploring how tools like generative AI and vibe coding are changing the way software is built and how companies operate.
